a legal document authorizing the police or another body to make an arrest or search premises
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"warrant"** means a legal document authorizing the police or another body to make an arrest or search premises. (वारंट)

 
 
• **Example: **The police obtained a ***warrant*** to search the suspect's house.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word for **"a legal document authorizing the police or another body to make an arrest or search premises"** is called **'warrant'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Permit **(अनुमति पत्र): An official document giving someone authorization to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** He applied for a*** permit ***to build a new garage on his property.
 
 
 
• **License **(लाइसेंस): An official permission or permit to do, use, or own something.
 
 
• **Example: **She finally got her driving ***license*** after passing the test.
 
 
 
• **Decree** (आदेश): An official order issued by a legal authority.
 
 
• **Example:** The king issued a ***decree*** banning hunting in the forest.
